status: Post-result exploratory amendment fixed before new fits; repeated cohort reuse disclosed
expanded_panel: 19 discovery_eligible markers in existing assay registry; four low-coverage/censored exploratory analytes not silently added
auxiliary_target_weight: five IGA cumulative threshold indicators each scaled by sqrt(1/5) after training-only standardization, so auxiliary block has comparable total scale to EASI
selection: Mean per-patient absolute EASI error in original-scale inner held-out predictions. Both panel-specific procedures select among the fixed families. Family-specific diagnostics retained; no outer or W24 selection.
paired_training_loss: sum_i w_i (y_i-f(x_i))^2 + lambda*(n_train/n_pairs)*sum_p[(y_p12-y_p0)-(f(x_p12)-f(x_p0))]^2 + alpha*||beta||^2; w_i inverse patient visit count normalized to mean 1. Intercept is unpenalized. RBF Nystroem basis, medians and scaling fitted only in training.
ordinal_assisted_loss: Weighted reduced-rank ridge predicts joint standardized EASI and IGA cumulative indicators; rank learned from training fitted-value singular vectors. Deployment uses blood features and EASI output only; recorded IGA 0-5 is auxiliary, not treated as a calibrated continuous response.
preprocessing: log2 molecular values already stored; per-fold median imputation for other missing molecules; no missingness indicators, no extra outcome or treatment/time/center/history/BSA input; no value clipping other than final EASI 0-72 bounds

cohorts.core: All 316 previously frozen comparison visits, 160 patients, identical original folds. Same eligibility supports fair comparisons; BSA is not a predictor here.
cohorts.extended_sensitivity: Observed EASI and age>=12 molecular-linked W0/W12/W24 visits, no BSA or three-marker completeness requirement, at least 8 available QC19. Existing core patient folds unchanged; added patients assigned deterministic fold by SHA256 ID/repeat. Additional training/evaluation is reported separately.

strata: Every visit separately; observed severity <=7, >7-21, >21 only for error diagnosis, never routing at prediction; treatment and centre descriptive
comparisons: Paired patient bootstrap using common sampled IDs; score each repeat first. Differences exploratory, conditional on saved predictions and not adjusted for multiple candidates.
freeze_policy: Do not replace current BSA-three-marker main formula from this search; all new candidates remain exploratory. No claim of optimal model or clinical interchangeability. W24 previously inspected and same cohort, not untouched external validation.
